basic_info.description: Like a drop of sunshine in the heart of Noe Valley, this cheerful Victorian home exudes personality, warmth and charm. The 2 bedroom, single-level layout includes a formal living room and dining room plus sunny, vintage kitchen that opens to a family lounge. The lovingly tended yard, part of an extra-deep lot, is punctuated by a towering Canary Island palm, fruit bearing trees and an elevated deck - the perfect space for morning meditation, al fresco dining or casual gatherings.   The garage comfortably accommodates one car, laundry area and all the workspace or storage one could hope for.   The gently sloping block is one of distinctive homes, friendly neighbors and convenient proximity to Billy Goat Hill, the Upper Noe Recreation Center, Sanchez Slow Street and too many restaurants and shops to name. Commuters will love being just minutes from MUNI, Hwy 101 and several shuttle stops.  Sewer line replaced in 2004, new roof in 2020, fresh exterior paint in 2022 and new furnace in 2023. Whether looking for a home that's move-in ready or primed for expansion, 474 29th will catch your eye and tug at your heart.
